description: FVA WMS Sturmwurfgefährdung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by owsproxy.lgl-bw.de. The portal shows the English title as "FVA WMS Assault Throw Risk" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
